Putnami starts new workspaces today. Migrating an existing repository, or
running Putnami next to your current tooling, is the next path we explore. Your
answers decide what we build first.

## What you run today

Languages, frameworks, databases, and how many services. Example: "3 Go
services with Gin, 1 Next.js app, PostgreSQL."

## How you build and deploy

Build tool, CI, and where it runs. Example: "Turborepo, GitHub Actions,
Kubernetes on GCP."

## Do you use coding agents?

Which ones, and for what kind of work.

## What you would want from Putnami

The problem you hope it solves for you.
